analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (182,600 KRW) vs SMA5 (192,260 KRW)/SMA20 (208,040 KRW)/SMA50 (233,174 KRW): below short/mid-term trends, diagnosed in weak territory.
· Position relative to SMA100 (246,496 KRW)/SMA200 (238,006 KRW): below long-term trends, strong weak territory.
· 52-week position (31.5%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.3→34.6) + diagnosed entering oversold + interpreted downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (87.7348→-568.6723) + diagnosed worsening + signal of continued weak trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 176,001 KRW) + interpreted band width at 30.80% level.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (179,200 KRW) + basis (Pivot S1, 20-day low).
· Swing resistance (209,000 KRW) + potential to enter neutral territory upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low forming) + interpreted as an attempt to bounce.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.89x) + reduced confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation) + specified conditions for entry.
analysis.patternNote: 5일 저가 181,400원이 20일 저가 179,200원 위에서 형성되며 반등 시도하는 Higher Low 패턴 진행 중.
analysis.patternNoteEn: A Higher Low pattern is in progress, with the 5-day low at 181,400 KRW forming above the 20-day low of 179,200 KRW, indicating an attempted bounce.
keyPoints: RSI 34.6으로 과매도 구간 진입, 1차 매수 고려 가능 수준.
MACD 히스토그램 악화 지속, 추세 전환 신호 미약.
ADX 22.9로 추세 형성 초기 단계, 방향성 확인 필요.
keyPointsEn: RSI at 34.6 entering oversold territory, potentially a level for initial buying.
MACD histogram continues to worsen, lacking strong trend reversal signals.
ADX at 22.9 in early trend formation stage, requiring directional confirmation.
analysis.riskNote: ADX 22.9로 추세 미약한 가운데 RSI 과매도 진입은 충격성 되돌림일 가능성 상존.
analysis.riskNoteEn: With a weak trend indicated by ADX at 22.9, RSI entering oversold territory carries the risk of being a shock reversal.
analysis.continuity: 직전 3거래일 연속 관망 판정 유지. 금일 RSI 과매도 진입으로 매수 점수 소폭 상승했으나, MACD 악화 및 ADX 추세 미약으로 관망 유지.
analysis.continuityEn: The wait-and-see stance has been maintained for the past 3 consecutive trading sessions. Today, RSI entering oversold territory slightly increased the buy score, but the worsening MACD and weak ADX trend warrant maintaining the wait-and-see approach.
